name: MIMAC
summary: MIMAC is a directional-detection programme at Modane using a matrix of small gas TPCs. Low-pressure gas and fast pixel readout reconstruct three-dimensional tracks of low-energy recoils.
detection_principle: Pixelated Micromegas measure the transverse charge distribution, while fast sampling measures drift time. Together they reconstruct three-dimensional recoil directions and discriminate electron tracks.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
